💪 Build: Powerful Build
Raw physical strength visible in every proportion — thick neck, heavy shoulders, dense arms, and a torso built for force application.

🖼️ Portrait only: changes how your character looks, never your Quirk or stats.

Portrait: Powerful frame — large-scale muscle visible across the entire body, thick neck, heavy shoulders, defined arms. The body reads as trained for force. Female: shoulders heavy above a defined waist, strong neck, firm rounded jaw, the chest line above a firm waist. Male: neck thick, shoulders heavy, jaw square, a heavy flat chest. Otherwise (a Mutant body plan): the character's own structure at heavy power.

Visual selection only: keep the character's actual adult age, body plan and any Mutant features; never change anatomy to fit this choice. It adds no Quirk effect, injury, item, license or affiliation.
